verdicts.reason: In FMap.lean, FAPPLY returns ARB on none, so Lean proves FAPPLY (FEMPTY : FMap Nat Nat) 0 = ARB by rfl. In HOL4, FAPPLY FEMPTY 0 reduces to OUTL (INR one) (finite_mapScript.sml:176-182), OUTL is only specified by OUTL (INL x) = x (sumScript.sml:287), and ARB is an unconstrained constant (boolScript.sml:245). Thus HOL4 leaves equality with ARB open, making Lean's provable equation in the mapped vocabulary a genuine V-C violation.
